title: Design Studio Selections Design Credit Terms
content:
Design credit on a Design Studio Selections file offsets option prices; it is granted by the package or by Calloway and is held on the file until used or forfeited.

**(a) Package allowance.** The package allowance is granted once, when the first appointment is held.

**(b) Builder goodwill.** The clause under which a studio manager may grant builder goodwill credit up to the package's goodwill credit cap in total on one file is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for builder goodwill credit.

**(c) Promotional credit.** Promotional credit may be granted only as a published promotion. Promotional credit applied may not exceed the package's promotional credit cap percent of the option total at the time it is applied.

**(d) Order of application.** Credits are applied to option lines in the order package allowance, promotional credit, builder goodwill, and never to fee lines. The package allowance reaches structural, electrical and plumbing lines only where the package allows the allowance to be applied to them.

**(e) No cash value.** Credit has no cash value: unused credit is forfeited when the file is finalized where the package provides that the allowance expires at finalization, and when the file is cancelled.

**(f) State of the file.** Credit may be applied only while the file status is in selection or structural closed, as shown on that file's record.

**Clause (f) by status**

| File status | Credit may be applied |
|---|---|
| In selection | Yes |
| Structural closed | Yes |
| Awaiting appointment, finalized, delivered, cancelled | No |

**Points of judgement**

- A design consultation fee line, a package fee line, a card convenience fee line and a returned payment fee line are fee lines; no credit is applied to them.
- Where a line can take more than one kind of credit, package allowance comes before promotional credit, and promotional credit before builder goodwill.
- *Hypothetical cap figure:* with a promotional credit cap of 25 percent and an option total of 8000.00 when the promotional credit is applied, the promotional credit applied may not exceed 2000.00.

superseded_clauses: A studio manager may grant builder goodwill credit up to goodwill_credit_cap_usd in total on one file;
